environment.authentication: claude.ai subscription OAuth / firstParty; login verified
environment.screen_method: external runtime UI observation plus actual screenshot
environment.screen_interval: actual monotonic interval upper bound recorded per observation; no pixel timestamp
environment.retention: same private bundle; owner minjunkim-dev; delete<=30days after actual end
environment.feature_flags: default OFF; explicit local iOS core flow and timing ON

measurement.boundary: button to checked result screen; server alone is unknown

costs.basis: offline planning assumption; not provider pricing or billing

same_input_http.boundary: actual Rust development HTTP; independent iOS and HTTP repeat
actual Rust development HTTP; independent iOS and HTTP repeat

screen_observation.sample_interval_definition: maximum interval between recorded external observation timestamps; requested internal poll=500ms is not the actual bound
screen_observation.method: single persistent Node performance.now before successful tap to first verified screenshot; XcodeBuildMCP runtime UI + screenshot
screen_observation.limitations: upper includes automation and screenshot delay; not first pixel time; independent calls cannot fill launch screen_missing; no retry to improve sample count

retention.delete_method: Issue 담당자가 private 실행 디렉터리와 이번 QA 시뮬레이터 복제·사진을 삭제한다.
